data.name: Aafiyah
data.gender_notes: Aafiyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aafiyah means being in a state of well-being, free from harm or illness. It signifies a person's good health and safety. The name Aafiyah carries the meaning “Healthy, Sound” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aafiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody healthy, sound and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Aafiyah is associated with being protected from harm and evil, as mentioned in Quranic verses.
data.etymology: Aafiyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Healthy, Sound.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aafiyah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: عافية
in_arabic.long_meaning: عافية کا مطلب ہے سلامتی، تندرستی اور بیماری سے آزادی۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کے 'عاف' فعل سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا معنی ہے 'صحت مند ہونا' یا 'بیماری سے بچنا'۔ قرآن کریم میں بھی 'عافية' کا ذکر ہے جہاں اللہ تعالیٰ اپنے بندوں کو سلامتی اور تندرستی عطا کرنے کی دعا کرتے ہیں۔ اسلامی روایات میں 'عافية' کو ایک عظیم نعمت کے طور پر شمار کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_urdu.name: عافیہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: عافیہ نام کا مطلب ہے سلامتی، تندرستی اور بیماری سے آزادی۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کی 'عاف' جڑ سے نکلا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'صحت مند ہونا' یا 'بیماری سے بچنا'۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم روایات میں 'عافیہ' ایک مقبول نام ہے جو خوبصورت معنی اور روحانی اہمیت کا حامل ہے۔

in_hindi.name: आफ़ियाह
in_hindi.long_meaning: आफ़ियाह नाम का अर्थ है सुरक्षा, स्वास्थ्य और रोगमुक्ति। यह नाम अरबी भाषा के 'عاف' क्रिया से उत्पन्न हुआ है जिसका अर्थ है 'स्वस्थ होना' या 'बीमारी से बचना'। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में 'आफ़ियाह' एक महत्वपूर्ण नाम है जो सुंदर अर्थ और आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है।

in_pashto.name: عافية
in_pashto.meaning: سلامتی، روغتیا، او د ناروغۍ څخه آزادي
in_pashto.long_meaning: عافية نوم معنی دی سلامتی، روغتیا او د ناروغۍ څخه آزادي. دا نوم د عربي ژبې د 'عاف' فعل څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنی یې دی 'روغ هونا' یا 'د ناروغۍ څخه بچنا'. په افغان او پښتون دودیزو کې 'عافية' یو مهم نوم دی چې ښکلی معنا او روحاني ارزښت لري.

in_english.name: Aafiyah
in_english.meaning: Safety, health, and freedom from disease
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aafiyah means safety, health, and freedom from disease. It is derived from the Arabic root 'عاف' (ʿ-ā-f), which means 'to be healthy' or 'to be free from disease'. In Islamic tradition, 'Aafiyah is considered a great blessing. The name has historical significance and spiritual importance across various Muslim cultures.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, the name Aafiyah is often given to babies as a blessing for good health and prosperity. It reflects the parents' hope for their child's well-being throughout their life. The name is also used as an endearment among family members and loved ones to express warmth and care.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Aafiyah holds deep significance in the teachings of Islam. The Prophet Muhammad (Peace Be Upon Him) emphasized the importance of seeking good health and well-being as a means to serve God and lead a virtuous life. The name Aafiyah reminds us of the Prophet's Hadith, "The believer's shade on the Day of Resurrection will be his good actions," and encourages us to prioritize our physical, emotional, and spiritual well-being in order to lead a fulfilling and successful life, both in this world and the next.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Healthy, Sound" symbolizes Aafiyah means being in a state of well-being, free from harm or illness. It signifies a person's good health and safety.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Aafiyah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of healthy, sound.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Aafiyah is mentioned in the Hadith as a name of a woman who was known for her piety and generosity. The name Aafiyah carried significant weight in that era.
